# Tipuri și clase de evenimente

The viewer adds an **Event type** column to every dataset that has an event column (`event`, `events`, `event_type` or `event_name`). Each game's own words are mapped to one of these kinds (upper and lower case alike); a word not listed counts as *Other*.

| Kind | Shown as | Words in the data |
|---|---|---|
| `position` | Poziție | `(empty)`, `position`, `pos`, `sample`, `move`, `vehicle` |
| `fire` | Foc tras | `burst`, `shot`, `gun_shot`, `fire`, `fire_start`, `fire_stop`, `weapon_fire`, `slash`, `hasfired`, `shoot`, `fired`, `tracer` |
| `launch` | Lansare (rachetă, proiectil, bombă) | `launch`, `launched`, `torpedo`, `throw`, `release` |
| `hit` | Lovitură | `hit`, `hit_critical`, `hit_severe`, `struck`, `impact`, `hasbeenhitby` |
| `miss` | Ratare | `miss`, `missed` |
| `explosion` | Explozie | `explosion`, `flak`, `he`, `molotov`, `inferno`, `smoke`, `flash`, `explode` |
| `damage` | Daune | `hurt`, `damage`, `damaged`, `module_destroyed`, `wounded`, `fire_on`, `blind` |
| `kill` | Doborâre | `kill`, `kills` |
| `death` | Moarte | `death`, `dead`, `died`, `killed` |
| `destroyed` | Distrus | `destroyed` |
| `crash` | Prăbușire | `crash`, `crashed` |
| `eject` | Catapultare | `eject`, `ejected`, `bailout`, `bailedout` |
| `spawn` | Apariție | `spawn`, `respawn`, `revived`, `created` |
| `despawn` | Dispariție | `despawn`, `removed`, `leftarea`, `timeout` |
| `takeoff` | Decolare | `takenoff`, `takeoff` |
| `landing` | Aterizare | `landed`, `landing` |
| `touchdown` | Contact cu solul | `touchdown`, `touch_and_go` |
| `stop` | Oprire | `stop`, `parked` |
| `rearm` | Reînarmare / realimentare | `rearm`, `rearmed`, `refuel`, `refuelled`, `refueled`, `repair`, `repaired` |
| `capture` | Capturare / obiectiv | `captured`, `capture`, `neutralised`, `neutralized`, `plant`, `defuse` |
| `decoy` | Momeală | `flare`, `chaff`, `decoy`, `countermeasure` |
| `message` | Mesaj | `chat`, `message`, `command`, `bookmark`, `debug`, `comment` |
| `other` | Altele | `grenade`, `projectile`, `nade`, `thrown`, `flight` |

## Vehicle classes

The **Vehicle class** and **Target class** columns use these classes, worked out from vehicle names (through the [figure catalogue](figures.md)) and type columns.

| Class | Shown as |
|---|---|
| `fighter` | Vânător |
| `attack` | Avion de atac |
| `bomber` | Bombardier |
| `otherAir` | Altă aeronavă |
| `helicopter` | Elicopter |
| `tank` | Tanc |
| `armoured` | Vehicul blindat |
| `spaa` | Apărare antiaeriană |
| `artillery` | Artilerie |
| `truck` | Camion / mașină |
| `ship` | Navă |
| `submarine` | Submarin |
| `infantry` | Infanterie |
| `weapon` | Armă |
| `decoy` | Momeală |
| `structure` | Structură |
| `other` | Altele |
